description: Import picks into a list from one link: a Google Maps list shared with "Anyone with the link" (every place, in order, with the owner's notes; pasting it again adds only new places), a Google Maps place (one pick) or a public YouTube playlist (up to 500 videos). Spotify playlists and Letterboxd lists no longer let apps read them; the tool says so, and the person can bring their export in Curated instead. For a whole list you want to sort first, use start_import.

list.description: Which list: exact slug, handle/slug, or id from a previous result.

url.description: A Google Maps shared list or place link (maps.app.goo.gl works), Spotify playlist, YouTube playlist (a link with list=) or Letterboxd list URL.

name: import_from_url
title: Import from a link
